eslau:
Endorse the proposed annual growth rate for Breslau within the Designated Growth Areas (i.e., 550 people per year) and the infill / intensification areas (140 people per year), totaling 690 people per year, that informs the Preferred Staging Plan for Breslau based on the rationale provided in Section 2.1 of this Report.
Endorse the proposed servicing strategy for Breslau that will inform the Preferred Staging Plan for Breslau based on the rationale provided in Section 2.3 of this Report subject to Council being satisfied that a feasible and sustainable fiscal plan is in place to finance the required infrastructure, which may include upper levels of government funding and/or cost-sharing arrangements to substantially supplement the Township’s Development Charge reserves (i.e., the “Financial Plan”).
Endorse the Preferred Staging Plan for Breslau as shown in
Attachment 5
,
which includes the projected growth allocation and sequential order of development as outlined in
Attachment No. 6,
subject to an appropriate Financial Plan for servicing as noted in Recommendation No. 2.
Direct Staff to continue to pursue funding options with the upper levels of government and/or through public/private cost-sharing arrangements to substantially supplement the cost to provide the required servicing and infrastructure that will facilitate growth in Breslau in accordance with an appropriate Financial Plan for the Township to implement the Preferred Staging Plan.
Direct Staff to pursue a Development Charges by-law amendment prior to 2028.
Endorse the Proposed Contingency Staging Plan for Breslau as shown in
Attachment No. 7
which provides flexibility to accommodate Area 16 and includes the projected growth allocation and sequential order of development as outlined in
Attachment No. 8,
subject to budget approval by Council to finance the improvements to the Breslau wet-well adjacent to the Victoria Street Pumping Station in 2029
,
until the Township is satisfied with an appropriate Financial Plan to provide the required servicing and infrastructure to facilitate the Preferred Staging Plan for Breslau.
Direct Staff to report back to Council in 2028 or sooner if warranted, on the progress of an appropriate Financial Plan to determine if Council should continue to implement the Proposed Contingency Staging Plan for Breslau as noted in Recommendation No. 5 or transition to the Preferred Staging Plan.
Direct Staff to provide an update on the progress of the Staging Plan for Breslau and to adjust the Plans accordingly related to such matters as population yield, growth allocation, updated Population Per Units (PPUs), wastewater flows, phasing, etc., as part of a future staging and development report for Council’s consideration on an annual basis.
